summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K/A amending its May 2026 Form 8-K to correct the source of its monthly extension fee. The company, a blank-check SPAC, deposited $50,000 into its trust account on May 21, 2026, to extend its business-combination deadline from May 22 to June 22, 2026. Of that fee, $25,000 was paid by sponsor Hercules Capital Management VII and $25,000 by target WISeSat.Space under a November 9, 2025 business combination agreement. The company issued a $25,000 unsecured promissory note to the sponsor. The filing corrects prior disclosure. Watch for extension fee funding and completion of the initial business combination before the extended deadline.
